summary: Enriched the validation rules to include SKU uniqueness and price validation, and added a new non-functional requirement for price history retention. Also enhanced the acceptance criteria for item deletion to include stock validation.

additions.description: The system must retain a complete price history for each product variant, ensuring that completed orders display the exact price paid at the time of purchase.
additions.rationale: This ensures accurate order records and prevents disputes due to price changes.

modifications.original_description: Item name must be unique within the catalog.
modifications.enhanced_description: Item name must be unique within the catalog, and each product variant must have a unique SKU code.
modifications.rationale: SKU uniqueness is essential for inventory tracking and order fulfillment.

modifications.original_description: Item price must be a positive number.
modifications.enhanced_description: Item price must be a positive number and explicitly stored with a currency code.
modifications.rationale: Explicit currency handling is required for multi-region storefronts and accurate order processing.

modifications.original_description: Given an existing item, when admin clicks delete and confirms, the item is removed from the catalog.
modifications.enhanced_description: Given an existing item, when admin clicks delete and confirms, the item is removed from the catalog only if no active orders or carts contain that item; otherwise, a warning is shown.
modifications.rationale: This prevents accidental deletion of items that are part of active transactions.
